role: Computed ONLY after the primary WP-1b result is frozen and tagged. Never primary. Cannot influence the primary verdict, the calibration gate, sample membership, or any scientific knob. Zero API.
implementation: src/benchmark/wp1b/exploratory.py (constants must equal the values below; any mismatch is a protocol violation)

rmcss_probabilities.source: research/stage5-v2-final/deployment_artifact.json (config_sha256 8925d29a8e065bc864cd16e755ac0e896c7675b4a12f68fb66c35e5bd644ea95) applied to the label-free view of research/saleor-reserve-300-rmcss/candidate_rows_saleor300.parquet
rmcss_probabilities.check: thresholding at 0.20 must reproduce the frozen RM-CSS set for every scored task (verified: 300/300)

X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.question: Can a task-level cascade (run RM-CSS on every task; escalate only the least-confident tasks to the Agent) recover agent quality at a fraction of agent cost?
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.uncertainty_U1: sum over the task's RM-CSS candidate rows of p*(1-p) (expected number of coin-flip decisions); escalate in descending U1; ties by sha256('wp1b-x6-v1-2026-09-22' + task_id) ascending
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.uncertainty_U2_secondary: SIP-empty tasks first (descending U1 within), then the rest by descending U1

policies.REPLACE: escalated task uses the Agent set
policies.UNION: escalated task uses RM-CSS set UNION Agent set

X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.cost: cascade pays RM-CSS View A for every task + Agent cost for escalated tasks (frozen list price)
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.random_null: 2000 random escalation sets of the same size (numpy default_rng seed 20260922); one-sided p = (1 + #random F1 >= policy F1) / 2001
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.oracle_reference: REPLACE with tasks ordered by per-task F1 gain (Agent - RM-CSS); descriptive upper reference only
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.reading: ESCALATION_BETTER_THAN_RANDOM iff, at k = 0.20 with U1, REPLACE or UNION has p < 0.025 (two policies, alpha split) AND pooled F1 - RM-CSS F1 >= +0.02; otherwise ESCALATION_NO_GAIN
X6_confidence_escalation_frontier.also_reported: paired bootstrap CI (10,000, seed 20260920) of policy F1 - RM-CSS F1 at k = 0.20; gain capture = (best policy gain at 0.20) / (best 100% gain) when the 100% gain exceeds 0.02; full frontier table; SVG frontier figure

X7_heterogeneity.report: per-stratum n, pooled F1 per arm, D (RM-CSS - Agent) with a paired bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples, seed 20260920)

metrics: USD per true-positive file (ratio of sums)
ICER = (agent USD - RM-CSS USD) / (agent TP - RM-CSS TP) when the agent finds more TP
X8_cost_effectiveness.ci: paired bootstrap (10,000, seed 20260920) of the ratio of sums; undefined draws (0 TP) reported as a share

X9_budget_binding.report: agent F1 / EMPTY rate for forced finals (call 8) vs voluntary finals; calls-used histogram; agent F1 by calls used

X10_zero_generative_dense_anchor.definition: Qwen3-Embedding-8B file ranking from research/saleor-reserve-300-rmcss/full_file_scores_saleor300.parquet (dense_rank ascending); size-matched to RM-CSS (k_t = |RM-CSS_t|, 0 -> empty) and fixed k in {1, 3, 5}
X10_zero_generative_dense_anchor.report: pooled F1 and difference vs RM-CSS with paired bootstrap CI

X11_agent_tool_quality.report: share of executed tool requests that exactly duplicate an EARLIER non-adjacent request in the same task (the frozen rejection rule only catches consecutive repeats); share of search_text calls with 0 results; share of multi-word searches and their zero-result share
X11_agent_tool_quality.reading: label-free instrument descriptive; motivates future agent-tool work; not a knob change
